# Raimov Academy

Stores the future professional education line: audiences, learning outcomes, curriculum, faculty, delivery formats, certification wording, evidence, professional lead funnel and launch gates.

Academy is not yet a launched school and is not the first educational product. Under `DEC-864`, **Whole-Person Treatment Planning Intensive** is the first approved educational product direction and **RAIMOV Whole-Person Study Club** is the professional community; Academy may follow only after documented methodology, demonstrated demand, an approved programme, faculty/reviewer ownership, evidence and legal/release gates.

First educational product contour: `docs/raimov/academy/WHOLE_PERSON_TREATMENT_PLANNING_INTENSIVE.md`.

Do not publish course dates, accreditation, certificates, faculty, prices or outcomes until each item has an owner, evidence and approval.

Patient marketing and professional education must use separate routes, forms, consent wording and analytics.
